question: To whom should one not give, O goddess, among revilers of Shiva and slanderers of kula Bhairava?
premises: kula Bhairava is the protected figure
inference: The verse forbids giving to those who revile Shiva or slander kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: whether na governs dadyāt from context
plain_english: Not to a Shiva-reviler, O goddess, nor to a slanderer of kula Bhairava.
